title: Selection from Hierarchical Data with Conformal e-values
one_line_what_it_does: Conformal selection (FDR via e-BH) under hierarchical exchangeability (groups exchangeable, units exchangeable within group); subsampling conformal e-values (one random calibration unit per group) and hierarchical conformal e-values (1/N_k group weights); test groups M>=1; cFDR conditional on group sizes only (marginal over new groups); sims K=200 calibration groups, M=20-200 test groups; names group-feature-conditional FDR as open
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: (i) fully; (iii) the subsampled and donor-weighted procedures; leaves (ii) and small-K power open

title: Distribution-free inference with hierarchical data (HCP)
authors: Yonghoon Lee, Rina Foygel Barber, Rebecca Willett
one_line_what_it_does: Defines hierarchical exchangeability; HCP prediction sets with 1/((K+1)N_k) group-weighted calibration; second-moment coverage for repeated measures; notes small-K undercoverage of pooled variants
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Source of the hierarchical-exchangeability assumption and donor-weighted calibration; prediction sets, not selection

title: Predictive Inference in Multi-environment Scenarios
authors: John Duchi, Suyash Gupta, Kuanhao Jiang, Pragya Sur
one_line_what_it_does: Multi-environment jackknife/split conformal; hierarchical coverage and (alpha,delta) coverage of fraction of new-environment examples; Section 7 shows environment-conditional coverage is essentially impossible (incl. discrete environments) while approximate versions hold
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: (ii) for coverage, not FDR; the impossibility template for donor-conditional guarantees

title: Testing for Outliers with Conformal p-values
authors: Stephen Bates, Emmanuel Candes, Lihua Lei, Yaniv Romano, Matteo Sesia
one_line_what_it_does: Conformal p-values are PRDS so BH controls FDR marginally over calibration data; calibration-conditional (PAC) p-values via concentration for FDR conditional on calibration set
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: (ii) analogue: marginal vs calibration-conditional FDR and the price in power; calibration unit here is a spot, not a donor

title: Selection by Prediction with Conformal p-values
one_line_what_it_does: Conformal selection: BH on conformal p-values with FDR control under exchangeability
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Base procedure the claim extends

title: Model-free selective inference under covariate shift via weighted conformal p-values
one_line_what_it_does: Weighted conformal selection (WCS) for covariate shift; p-values not PRDS so special procedure
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Alternative route if donors are treated as covariate-shifted

title: Batch Predictive Inference
authors: Yonghoon Lee, Eric Tchetgen Tchetgen, Edgar Dobriban
one_line_what_it_does: Prediction sets for functions of a test batch; selection with control of number of false claims; informative with small calibration samples; exchangeable (non-hierarchical) data
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Shared-batch structure and small-calibration power; no donor hierarchy

title: Finding Distributions that Differ, with False Discovery Rate Control
authors: Yonghoon Lee, Edgar Dobriban, Eric Tchetgen Tchetgen
one_line_what_it_does: Batch conformal p-values with PRDS across groups; BH FDR control when testing which groups differ from a reference
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: FDR at group level; not unit selection within a new group

title: Generalized Hierarchical Conformal Prediction
authors: Soham Mallick, Eric Tchetgen Tchetgen, Edgar Dobriban, Yonghoon Lee
one_line_what_it_does: HCP when a few labelled observations from the test group are available; random donation of reference group size restores symmetry; prediction sets only
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Selection analogue with a few labelled spots in the new donor does not appear to exist

title: Transductive conformal inference with adaptive scores
authors: Ulysse Gazin, Gilles Blanchard, Etienne Roquain
one_line_what_it_does: Joint law of conformal p-values is a Polya urn depending only on (n,m); concentration of their ECDF; novelty-detection guarantees
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Tool for finite-K characterization of joint p-value behavior

title: Adaptive novelty detection with false discovery rate guarantee
authors: Ariane Marandon, Lihua Lei, David Mary, Etienne Roquain
one_line_what_it_does: Adaptive-score conformal novelty detection with FDR guarantee
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Exchangeable setting only

title: Derandomized Novelty Detection with FDR Control via Conformal E-values
authors: Meshi Bashari, Amir Epstein, Yaniv Romano, Matteo Sesia
one_line_what_it_does: Conformal e-values with e-BH to derandomize novelty detection
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Possible derandomization of the subsampling e-value

title: Optimized Conformal Selection
one_line_what_it_does: Selection with data-dependent score optimization via conditional calibration
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Power route; exchangeable setting

title: Revamping Conformal Selection With Optimal Power: A Neyman-Pearson Perspective
one_line_what_it_does: Likelihood-ratio style selection rule maximizing power under FDR control
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Power route; exchangeable setting

title: Multi-Distribution Robust Conformal Prediction
one_line_what_it_does: Coverage when test distribution is an unknown member or mixture of K source distributions
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Non-exchangeable-donor alternative for prediction sets

authors: Ziang Song, Ying Jin, Emmanuel Candes
one_line_what_it_does: High-probability simultaneous FDP bounds for conformal selection and outlier detection
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: FDP (not FDR) route for single-new-donor guarantees; exchangeable setting

title: Beyond Fixed False Discovery Rates: Post-Hoc Conformal Selection with E-Variables
one_line_what_it_does: Post-hoc conformal selection with e-variables; cites Lee-Ren hierarchical e-values
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Cites the hierarchical work, does not extend it

title: Multi-Condition Conformal Selection
one_line_what_it_does: Conjunctive/disjunctive conditions under conformal selection; mentions hierarchical conformal e-values in related work
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Marker-program selection (multiple conditions) route

title: Multivariate Conformal Selection
one_line_what_it_does: Conformal selection for multivariate responses
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Marker-program selection route

title: Conformalized Multiple Testing after Data-dependent Selection
one_line_what_it_does: Selective conformal p-values with BH after data-dependent selection
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Not hierarchical

title: HCPclust: Hierarchical Conformal Prediction for Clustered Data with Missing Responses
one_line_what_it_does: HCP prediction regions for clustered data with MAR missingness, repeated cluster-level splitting and Cauchy combination
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Prediction regions only

title: TISSUE: uncertainty-calibrated prediction of single-cell spatial transcriptomics improves downstream analyses
one_line_what_it_does: Conformal-style calibrated intervals for imputed single-cell ST (scRNA-seq reference, not H&E); reduces false discoveries in DE
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Nearest biology method with conformal-type calibration; no donor hierarchy, no FDR guarantee for selection

title: Benchmarking the translational potential of spatial gene expression prediction from histology
one_line_what_it_does: Benchmark of 11 histology-to-ST methods; no error-rate guarantees
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Confirms absence of guaranteed selection in the histology-to-ST literature

title: Pitfalls of Conformal Predictions for Medical Image Classification
one_line_what_it_does: Conformal prediction fails under shift in dermatology/histopathology
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Motivation only

title: A Multi-Cohort Validation of Censoring-Aware Conformal Lower Predictive Bounds for Pathology Survival Models
one_line_what_it_does: Patient as exchangeable unit for pathology conformal bounds
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Patient-level exchangeability practice

title: Uncertainty-Aware Multiscale Treatment Response Forecasting in Advanced NSCLC Using Residual-Variance Conformal Prediction
one_line_what_it_does: Patient-block exchangeability for voxel-level conformal intervals (unpublished preprint)
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Hierarchical exchangeability used informally in imaging

title: A Comparison of Some Approximate Confidence Intervals for a Single Proportion for Clustered Binary Outcome Data
one_line_what_it_does: Clustered-binomial CIs; cluster bootstrap for sensitivity/specificity (Rutter)
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Biostatistics vocabulary for estimating precision of selected sets with clustered data; no guarantee-based selection
